description:
US-government macro and liquidity series: Fed net liquidity (balance sheet
minus Treasury General Account minus reverse repo, USD trillions, weekly, with the
4-week percent change), 10-year real yield, 10-year breakeven inflation, 5y5y
forward inflation and the effective fed funds rate (percent, each with its prior
value and date), the Treasury yield curve (1M-30Y) with the 10Y-2Y spread history
(percentage points, negative = inverted), private nonresidential fixed investment
(CAPEX, USD billions SAAR) and CFTC E-mini S&P 500 positioning by trader class
(net contracts). Federal Reserve, NY Fed, Treasury, BEA, CFTC and Chicago Fed
sources only; third-party-licensed credit-spread series are not included.
Self-caching (6 h). No parameters.
name: get_macro_liquidity
title: Get Macro Liquidity
